answer: A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The quartz counter is kept in yarrow and spiral shows each reset. Anyone hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1035 identities would post 4675 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
